description:
Cast Carnage by paying {2}{B}{R}. When it enters, it triggers, returning Deceptive Frostkite from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Put Deceptive Frostkite into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Deceptive Frostkite's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 2.
